subject.title: fix(marketplaces): allow trusted feed key rotation

question: Should authenticated monotonic metadata from a snapshot signed by a now-removed key remain authoritative solely to reject lower-sequence feeds after ordinary key rotation, and what explicit revocation path must clear that authority?
rationale: The code can correctly implement either policy, but only maintainers can define the intended security boundary between anti-rollback continuity and emergency key revocation.

options.title: Approve retained rollback metadata
options.body: Document that ordinary key rotation preserves previously authenticated sequence metadata for rollback checks, with a named operator recovery path for emergency key revocation.

options.title: Require key continuity
options.body: Reject the design unless the new trusted key set cryptographically authorizes the retained metadata from the prior key.

options.title: Pause pending trust specification
options.body: Hold this PR until the hosted-feed specification defines revocation, recovery, and rollback semantics.

recommendation.title: Approve retained rollback metadata
recommendation.body: Document that ordinary key rotation preserves previously authenticated sequence metadata for rollback checks, with a named operator recovery path for emergency key revocation.

likelyOwner.reason: They are the identifiable contributor carrying both this narrowly scoped rotation fix and the related hosted-feed trust work; a repository security owner should make the final policy call.
